veranderings.voor: in die Indiese Oseaan oos van Mosambiek
veranderings.na: in die Indiese Oseaan, oos van Mosambiek
veranderings.rede: A comma separates the two place phrases so 'oos van Mosambiek' is not read as part of the ocean's name or location.

veranderings.blok: Zanzibar: eilande wat aan 'n land behoort
veranderings.voor: Daar lê see tussen hulle, maar
veranderings.na: Daar lê see tussen Zanzibar en die vasteland, maar
veranderings.rede: 'hulle' could mean the islands among themselves or Zanzibar and Tanzania; naming both sides removes the doubt, and 'vasteland' avoids the odd claim of sea between Zanzibar and the country it belongs to.

vlae.teks: 'n Eiland is 'n stuk land met water aan alle kante.
vlae.rede: The study text gives a shorter version of the decided definition of 'eiland' (it omits 'kleiner as die kleinste kontinent'); a person should decide whether this counts as a second definition of the term within the year.
